sourceClaimMap.claim: A private deed is not the same as changing registered title ranking.
Under the Land Title Act 1994 (Qld), registered instruments have priority according to when they were lodged, not according to when they were executed.

The priority of registered mortgages may be amended by registering an instrument amending priority, which must specify the order of all affected registered mortgages and be executed by all mortgagees affected.
On registration of that instrument, the mortgages have priority in the order specified.
Changing registered land-title order is a separate, formal process.
The Personal Property Securities Act 2009 includes default priority rules for security interests in personal property, and it also provides for voluntary subordination of security interests.
Those PPSA rules do not decide real-property mortgage ranking.
